_note: Shared Session Planner FAQ. True for every partner that has Session Planner alongside the LMS. Video codes live in session-planner-videos.json — reference them, never paste them into a partner config.
_support: Session Planner is ALSO Coaches' Voice — two platforms, not two companies. Do not write copy that implies a third party ('they build it', 'their product'). The only split is the support desk: LMS questions to {{supportEmail}}, Session Planner questions to {{plannerSupport}}. One rule, no judgement call for the coach.
_naming: It is 'Session Planner' in all partner-facing copy. Never 'Sport Session Planner', never 'SSP' — not in prose, not in anchors, not in nav labels.

items.q: How do I open it, and why is it asking me to log in again?
a: Use the green Session Planner button at the top right of My Learning. It opens in a new tab and leaves your learning where it was.

Session Planner is a separate platform with its own account, and it is not single sign-on. You log in with your Session Planner username and password, which are not the same as your learning platform ones and may well be a different password entirely. Worth saving both.

Both are Coaches’ Voice platforms, but each has its own support desk. Anything about Session Planner — details you have not been given, a password that will not reset, a session that will not save — goes to {{plannerSupport}}. Anything about your learning platform stays with {{supportEmail}}.

items.q: Why use this instead of a whiteboard?
a: A whiteboard drawing lasts about ninety seconds. This one you keep.

Build the session once and adapt it next week rather than redrawing it. Animate it in 3D so your players watch the movement instead of trying to read arrows on a diagram. Then send it to them — email, web link, QR code or WhatsApp — so they arrive at the session already knowing what it is.

items.q: Where are the Session Planner tutorials?
a: Session Planner has its own help centre — thirty-three short videos covering the editor, the 3D space, animation and sharing. It lives inside the product, so log in first and it opens from the menu.
You do not need all thirty-three. The ones below are what get you working; come back for the rest when you want a specific trick.

blurbs.coachIntro: Build a session, animate it in 3D so your players see the movement rather than read a diagram, and send it to them before they get to the ground. Next week, adapt it instead of starting again. It is a separate platform from your learning one, with its own login.
blurbs.adminIntro: Session Planner has its own club administration, unconnected to the learning platform. Adding a coach to one does not add them to the other, and the accounts are not linked — there is no single sign-on between them. Budget for doing both.
blurbs.adminOffboard: When someone leaves, revoke both. Removing a coach from the learning platform leaves their Session Planner access untouched, and vice versa. Two products, two off-boarding steps.
